```{=html}
<style>
/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   GLOBAL TOKENS
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
:root {
  --bg:        #f8f7f4;
  --surface:   #ffffff;
  --ink:       #1a1a2e;
  --ink-muted: #5c5c7a;
  --accent:    #2d6a9f;
  --accent2:   #4db6ac;
  --rule:      rgba(45, 106, 159, 0.18);
  --mono:      'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
  --serif:     'DM Serif Display', Georgia, serif;
  --sans:      'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   BASE TYPOGRAPHY
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.reveal {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--bg);
}

.reveal h1, .reveal h2, .reveal h3 {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  line-height: 1.15;
  text-transform: none;
  text-shadow: none;
}

.reveal h1 { font-size: 2.6rem; }
.reveal h2 { font-size: 1.9rem; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--rule); padding-bottom: 0.4em; margin-bottom: 0.8em; }
.reveal h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; color: var(--accent); font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.reveal p, .reveal li { font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 300; }
.reveal strong { font-weight: 500; color: var(--accent); }
.reveal code { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.88em; background: rgba(45,106,159,0.08); padding: 0.1em 0.35em; border-radius: 3px; color: var(--accent); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   SLIDE LAYOUT
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.reveal .slides section {
  padding: 2.5rem 3.5rem;
  text-align: left;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   COVER SLIDE
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.cover-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100%;
  gap: 0;
}
.cover-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--accent);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.cover-title {
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 4rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1.08;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
}
.cover-sub {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 1.15rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  margin-bottom: 2.8rem;
}
.cover-rule {
  width: 64px;
  height: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 2.2rem;
}
.cover-meta {
  display: flex;
  gap: 2.5rem;
}
.cover-meta-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.15rem;
}
.cover-meta-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.cover-meta-value {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.cover-deco {
  position: absolute;
  right: 2rem;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  opacity: 0.04;
  font-family: var(--serif);
  font-size: 18rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  line-height: 1;
  user-select: none;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   CARD GRID
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.card-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}
.card-grid.four { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
.card {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 2.5px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
}
.card-icon {
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  display: block;
}
.card-title {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}
.card-body {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   EQUATION BLOCK
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.eq-block {
  background: var(--surface);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  padding: 1.2rem 1.8rem;
  margin: 1.2rem 0;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(45,106,159,0.06);
}
.eq-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  color: var(--accent);
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   CONCEPT BOX / CALLOUT
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.concept-box {
  background: rgba(45,106,159,0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(45,106,159,0.2);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.5rem;
  margin: 0.8rem 0;
}
.concept-box.teal {
  background: rgba(77,182,172,0.06);
  border-color: rgba(77,182,172,0.25);
}
.concept-box p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   PILL TAGS
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.pill-row {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
}
.pill {
  background: rgba(45,106,159,0.1);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  padding: 0.25em 0.75em;
  border-radius: 20px;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.pill.teal { background: rgba(77,182,172,0.12); color: #2a9d8f; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   TAXONOMY / MERMAID WRAPPERS
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.mermaid-wrap {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   COMPARISON TABLE
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.compare-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}
.compare-table th {
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  color: var(--accent);
  padding: 0.6rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--rule);
  text-align: left;
}
.compare-table td {
  padding: 0.65rem 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 300;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.compare-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.compare-table tr:hover td { background: rgba(45,106,159,0.03); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   ECOSYSTEM STACK
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.eco-stack {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}
.eco-layer {
  width: 340px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 6px;
  position: relative;
}
.eco-layer.l1 { background: #1a1a2e; color: #fff; font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
.eco-layer.l2 { background: #2d6a9f; color: #fff; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; width: 310px; }
.eco-layer.l3 { background: #4db6ac; color: #fff; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 1rem; width: 280px; }
.eco-arrow {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  padding: 0.1rem 0;
  line-height: 1;
}
.eco-caption {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  opacity: 0.7;
  margin-top: 0.2rem;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   TIMELINE / ANALYST FLOW
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.timeline {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  margin-top: 0.8rem;
  position: relative;
  padding-left: 1.6rem;
}
.timeline::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0.45rem;
  top: 0.5rem;
  bottom: 0.5rem;
  width: 1.5px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
}
.tl-item {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--rule);
}
.tl-item::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: -1.27rem;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  border: 2px solid var(--bg);
}
.tl-title {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
}
.tl-body {
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-muted);
  line-height: 1.45;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   SLIDE NUMBER & PROGRESS
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.reveal .progress { background: rgba(45,106,159,0.12); height: 2px; }
.reveal .progress span { background: var(--accent); }
.reveal .slide-number { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--ink-muted); background: transparent; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────
   MERMAID THEME OVERRIDE
───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.reveal .mermaid svg {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
</style>
```

## What Is a Model?

::::: columns
::: {.column width="55%"}
A **model** is a mathematical representation that captures the essential structure of a complex phenomenon.

<br>

```{=html}
<div class="eq-block">
  <div class="eq-label">General Form</div>
  $$Y = f(X_1, X_2, \ldots, X_p) + \varepsilon$$
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="eq-block">
  <div class="eq-label">Linear Specification</div>
  $$\hat{Y} = \beta_0 + \sum_{j=1}^{p} \beta_j X_j$$
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
```{=html}
<div style="margin-top: 0.5rem;">
  <div class="concept-box" style="margin-bottom: 0.7rem;">
    <p>🔍 <strong>Reductive capacity</strong><br>
    <span style="font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--ink-muted);">Simplify complex reality into tractable structure</span></p>
  </div>
  <div class="concept-box">
    <p>⚖️ <strong>Bias–Variance trade-off</strong><br>
    <span style="font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--ink-muted);">All models are wrong; some are useful — Box (1976)</span></p>
  </div>
  <div style="margin-top: 1rem;">
    <div class="pill-row">
      <span class="pill">Y → outcome</span>
      <span class="pill">X → predictors</span>
      <span class="pill">ε → noise</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
:::

## Principles of Modeling Software

::::: columns
::: {.column width="52%"}
Good modeling software should guide practitioners towards correct practice by **default**.

<br>

```{=html}
<div class="timeline">

  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Ease of Use</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Fluent, expressive syntax that maps to statistical concepts.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Reproducibility</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Seeds, versioned recipes, and serialisable workflows.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Error Protection</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Guard-rails against data leakage and invalid preprocessing order.</div>
  </div>

</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}

## Descriptive Models

::::: columns
::: {.column width="54%"}
**Goal:** understand *what is there*, not why.

<br>

```{=html}
<div class="timeline">
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Trend Detection</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Summarise central tendency and direction over time or across groups.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">LOESS Smoothing</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Locally-weighted regression reveals non-linear patterns without parametric assumptions.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Pattern Exploration</div>
    <div class="tl-body">EDA-driven — the model serves the analyst's curiosity, not an external standard.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```
:::

## Inferential Models

::::: columns
::: {.column width="54%"}
**Goal:** draw conclusions about a *population* from a *sample*.

<br>

```{=html}
<table class="compare-table">
<thead><tr><th>Concept</th><th>Description</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td><strong>Hypothesis</strong></td><td>H₀ vs Hₐ — formal claim about a parameter</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>p-value</strong></td><td>P(data | H₀) — probability under the null</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>CI</strong></td><td>Range of plausible parameter values</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Assumptions</strong></td><td>Normality, independence, homoscedasticity</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
```
:::

::: {.column width="46%"}
```{=html}

  <!-- shaded rejection region right -->
```

## Predictive Models

```{=html}
<p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--ink-muted); margin-bottom:1rem;">
<strong>Goal:</strong> maximise accuracy on <em>new, unseen</em> data — not just explain existing observations.
</p>

<div class="card-grid">

  <div class="card">
    <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--accent);letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.6rem;">Mechanistic</div>
    <div class="card-body" style="font-size:0.88rem;">
      Grounded in domain theory.<br><br>
      • Parameters have physical meaning<br>
      • Extrapolates more safely<br>
      • Requires strong assumptions<br><br>
      <em style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--ink-muted);">Example: pharmacokinetic dose-response</em>
    </div>
    <div class="pill-row" style="margin-top:0.8rem;">
      <span class="pill">ODE-based</span>
      <span class="pill">Theory-driven</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.65rem;color:var(--accent2);letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:0.6rem;">Empirical / ML</div>
    <div class="card-body" style="font-size:0.88rem;">
      Learned from data patterns alone.<br><br>
      • Parameters are latent / opaque<br>
      • Excels at interpolation<br>
      • Requires large samples<br><br>
      <em style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--ink-muted);">Example: gradient boosted trees</em>
    </div>
    <div class="pill-row" style="margin-top:0.8rem;">
      <span class="pill teal">Data-driven</span>
      <span class="pill teal">High fidelity</span>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<div class="concept-box" style="margin-top:0.9rem;">
  <p>Both types share a common imperative: <strong>generalisation</strong> — performance on data the model has never seen.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```

## Modeling Terminology

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Learning Paradigm

```{=html}
<table class="compare-table" style="margin-top:0.5rem;">
<thead><tr><th>Supervised</th><th>Unsupervised</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Known outcome Y</td><td>No outcome label</td></tr>
<tr><td>Learn f(X) → Y</td><td>Learn structure of X</td></tr>
<tr><td>Regression, Classification</td><td>Clustering, Dim. reduction</td></tr>
<tr><td>Ground-truth evaluation</td><td>Intrinsic evaluation</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Task Type

```{=html}
<table class="compare-table" style="margin-top:0.5rem;">
<thead><tr><th>Regression</th><th>Classification</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>Numeric outcome</td><td>Categorical outcome</td></tr>
<tr><td>RMSE, MAE, R²</td><td>Accuracy, AUC, F1</td></tr>
<tr><td>House prices</td><td>Spam detection</td></tr>
<tr><td>Continuous ŷ</td><td>Probability → class</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
```
:::

```{=html}
<div class="concept-box teal" style="margin-top:0.9rem;">
  <p>Choosing the right paradigm <em>before</em> touching data is the first critical modeling decision.</p>
</div>
```

## Iterative Modeling

::::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
Modeling is never linear. It is a **cycle** driven by feedback at every stage.

<br>

```{=html}
<div class="timeline">
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">EDA</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Distributions, correlations, outliers — what does the data tell us before we ask?</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Feature Engineering</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Transformations, interactions, and encodings that inject domain knowledge.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Tuning</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Hyperparameter search over a resampling scheme — never on the test set.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="tl-item">
    <div class="tl-title">Evaluation</div>
    <div class="tl-body">Honest performance on a held-out set after all decisions are finalised.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

## Case Study: Chicago Transit Authority

```{=html}
<p style="font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-bottom:1rem;">
Predicting daily rail ridership — an analyst's internal monologue.
</p>

<div class="card-grid four">

  <div class="card">
    <span class="card-icon">📊</span>
    <div class="card-title">Step 1 · Correlations</div>
    <div class="card-body">Which stations co-vary? Is ridership autocorrelated? Weekly and monthly seasonality emerges.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <span class="card-icon">🌡️</span>
    <div class="card-title">Step 2 · Weather</div>
    <div class="card-body">Temperature and precipitation enter as features. Cold/rainy days suppress ridership non-linearly.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <span class="card-icon">📅</span>
    <div class="card-title">Step 3 · Holidays</div>
    <div class="card-body">Federal and local holidays create sharp dips. Engineered as binary indicator variables.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="card">
    <span class="card-icon">🌲</span>
    <div class="card-title">Step 4 · Boosted Trees</div>
    <div class="card-body">XGBoost captures non-linear interactions between weather, calendar, and station-level effects.</div>
  </div>

</div>

<div class="concept-box teal" style="margin-top:1rem;">
  <p>The analyst never fits a model first — every feature is motivated by <strong>domain reasoning</strong> before statistical evidence.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
```

## Conclusions

::::: columns
::: {.column width="60%"}
```{=html}
<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.85rem;margin-top:0.5rem;">

  <div class="concept-box">
    <p>🔄 <strong>Modeling is iterative</strong><br>
    <span style="font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink-muted);">EDA, feature engineering, tuning, and evaluation form a cycle — not a sequence.</span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="concept-box">
    <p>🧰 <strong>Software shapes practice</strong><br>
    <span style="font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink-muted);">Good tools enforce reproducibility, protect against leakage, and make correct practice the default.</span></p>
  </div>

  <div class="concept-box teal">
    <p>🤝 <strong>ML and statistics are complementary</strong><br>
    <span style="font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink-muted);">Machine learning provides predictive fidelity; statistics provides inferential rigour. Both are needed.</span></p>
  </div>

</div>
```
:::
